description.en: Compare Git and SVN versions across up to 12 repositories and export Chinese Markdown release reports. Optional model analysis requires explicit approval and human review. Non-commercial source-available license; commercial use requires written authorization.
description.zh: 比较最多 12 个 Git/SVN 项目的版本差异，并导出中文 Markdown 发布报告。模型分析需明确授权并人工复核。采用非商业源码公开许可证，商业用途需书面授权。
